paragraphs: In Chullin 63a he raised an objection to Mar bar Rav Idai; Hyman gives the Yalkut, Zechariah, remez 578, reading as Rav Idi bar Shimi.[^1]

notes.text: The whole selected Davidson Chullin 63a paragraph has Rav Ada bar Shimi addressing Mar bar Rav Idai. The whole selected Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 578 paragraph instead has Rav Idi bar Shimi addressing Mar bar Rav Idi. Both digital forms and the supplied Idai form remain distinct; they do not establish an identity merger or correction history. The direction of the objection is retained.
